decoder: fixed W, coefficients=q95_train * relu(raw Gaussian recruitment); native actions from clipped excitation. Direct native clip [-1,1].
first_divergence: First of three consecutive 20 ms steps with joint trajectory RMS >=0.02 rad; excitation threshold RMS >=0.05 for three consecutive steps. Censor if never reached; differences only over simultaneous first episodes.
identity_gate: On development cohort, max same-state excitation error <2e-6; number of paired terminal outcome differences <=max(3, repeat baseline differences + 1). The raw identity projection solver is also verified on held-out commands.
extension_rule: Extend all arms of a task equally to 18M if any primary arm gains >=5 pp mean success or reduces mean terminal error >=10% between 6M and 12M on validation. One bounded extension; plateau is descriptive only.
extra_k_rule: Add one larger scratch arm on Reach and Pose if at 12M mean Reach K16 is >10 percentage points behind direct and the larger seed-11 bank improves projected development success by >=15 points over K16. Choose smallest passing K among 24,32.
efficiency: Normalized trapezoidal validation success AUC, plus first checkpoint attaining 25% and 50%; paired final differences per seed versus direct.
budgets: 1.008M,3M,6M,9M,12M training transitions; conditional 15M and 18M. Validation and final rollouts separate.
exclusions: Scratch primary comparison only. Optional BC and PCA/ICA omitted in this stage; all banks use the identical Reach teacher dataset, including Pose controllers.
cost_scope: Each arm shares historical demonstration and bank costs as appropriate; count once. Compare interaction efficiency and expose teacher prior separately.
